list.name: Kingston Flemings
list.comment: Flemings (back tightness) will not return to Friday's game against the Bulls.

list.name: Mouhamed Gueye
list.comment: Gueye (foot) is ready to begin on-court activities and will be re-evaluated in four weeks, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

list.name: Keshon Gilbert
list.comment: Gilbert (knee) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Bulls.

list.name: Asa Newell
list.comment: Newell (toe) has been ruled out for Friday's game against Chicago.

list.name: Henri Veesaar
list.comment: Veesaar was diagnosed with a torn right ACL and is expected to miss the 2026-27 season, the Hawks announced Monday.

list.name: Paul George
list.comment: George (illness) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against Toronto, Taylor Snow of the Celtics' official site reports.

list.name: Mikel Brown Jr.
list.comment: Brown (illness) is listed as questionable for Saturday's game against Memphis.

list.name: Nolan Traore
list.comment: Traore (calf) is listed as probable for Saturday's game against Memphis.

list.name: Brandon Miller
list.comment: Miller (groin) is listed as out for Thursday's game against Phoenix.

list.name: Kon Knueppel
list.comment: Knueppel (hamstring) was diagnosed with a left hamstring strain Sunday and will be re-evaluated in four weeks.

list.name: Dennis Schroder
list.comment: Schroder has been diagnosed with a left hamstring strain and will be reevaluated in two weeks, Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com reports.

list.name: Jalen Smith
list.comment: Smith (hand) exited Friday's 125-117 win over the Hawks in overtime and did not return, finishing with 15 points (6-15 FG, 1-6 3Pt, 2-2 FT), 12 rebounds, three assists and three steals across 32 minutes.

list.name: Dailyn Swain
list.comment: Swain (back) is out for Friday's game against the Hawks.

list.name: Tobe Awaka
list.comment: Awaka (back) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Hawks.

list.name: Caleb Wilson
list.comment: Wilson (hand) is expected to miss four to six weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

list.name: Evan Mobley
list.comment: Mobley (toe) is out for Friday's game against the Heat.

list.name: Sam Merrill
list.comment: Merrill (elbow) is listed as out for Wednesday's game against the Knicks.

list.name: Nae'Qwan Tomlin
list.comment: Tomlin is set to miss several weeks with a lower back stress reaction, Chris Fedor of The Cleveland Plain Dealer reports.

list.name: Max Christie
list.comment: Christie is questionable for Saturday's game against the Cavaliers due to a sprained left ankle.

list.name: Morez Johnson Jr.
list.comment: Johnson (left shin contusion) is listed as probable for Saturday against Cleveland.

list.name: Dereck Lively II
list.comment: Lively (foot) is listed as out for Thursday's game in Minnesota.

list.name: Tarik Biberovic
list.comment: Biberovic (heel) is out for Thursday's game against Minnesota.

list.name: Sergio de Larrea
list.comment: De Larrea (knee) has been ruled out for Thursday's game at Minnesota.

list.name: Julian Strawther
list.comment: Strawther (knee) was diagnosed with a left knee sprain Friday and will be re-evaluated in six weeks, Vinny Benedetto of The Denver Gazette reports.

list.name: Ugonna Onyenso
list.comment: Onyenso agreed to a two-way contract with the Pistons on Thursday.

list.name: Isaiah Joe
list.comment: Joe (hip) is out for Monday against the Wizards.

list.name: Jalen Duren
list.comment: Duren (hamstring) has begun on-court activity and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Hunter Patterson of The Athletic reports.

list.name: Stephen Curry
list.comment: Curry has been diagnosed with an oblique abdominal tear and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

list.name: Brandon Williams
list.comment: Williams (hamstring) will miss at least one week, per Anthony Slater of ESPN.com.

list.name: Kristaps Porzingis
list.comment: Porzingis announced on his social media that he's stepping away from basketball.

list.name: Moses Moody
list.comment: Moody (knee) is progressing toward a potential return between December and January after rupturing his left patellar tendon in March, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

list.name: Jimmy Butler III
list.comment: Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

list.name: Marcus Smart
list.comment: Smart has been suspended three games for throwing a punch during Wednesday's matchup against Golden State, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

list.name: Clint Capela
list.comment: Head coach Ime Udoka stated Monday that Capela (ankle) could be cleared to return either Nov. 15 in Washington or Nov. 16 in Miami, Lachard Binkley of SI.com reports.

list.name: Steven Adams
list.comment: Head coach Ime Udoka said Monday that Adams could return as soon as Sunday's game at Washington, Lachard Binkley of SI.com reports.

list.name: Aaron Nesmith
list.comment: Nesmith exited to the locker room in the final seconds of Friday's 106-104 win over the Knicks due to an apparent hand/wrist injury, Tony East of Forbes.com reports. He posted 18 points (7-10 FG, 2-3 3Pt, 2-2 FT), seven rebounds and one assist in 33 minutes.

list.name: Tyrese Haliburton
list.comment: Head coach Rick Carlisle said Wednesday that Haliburton (hamstring) will miss at least 10 more days, Alex Golden of SI.com reports.

list.name: Johnny Furphy
list.comment: Furphy (knee) is practicing with the G League's Noblesville Boom, per Alex Golden of SI.com.

list.name: Ben Sheppard
list.comment: Head coach Rick Carlise confirmed Sheppard will miss "months" after undergoing surgery to repair a torn meniscus in his left knee, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.

list.name: Brandon Ingram
list.comment: Ingram (Achilles) won't play in Friday's game against the Thunder, per Law Murray of The Athletic.

list.name: Yanic Konan Niederhauser
list.comment: Niederhauser (foot) is out for Tuesday's game against Phoenix, Ohm Youngmisuk of ESPN.com reports.

list.name: Bradley Beal
list.comment: Beal (knee) will not be ready for the start of the regular season, NBA writer Justin Russo reports.

list.name: Jordan Miller
list.comment: Miller underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn left rotator cuff and will be re-evaluated in six months, per Law Murray of The Athletic.

list.name: Quentin Grimes
list.comment: Grimes (finger) said he expects to return to action Sunday against the Suns, according to Ricardo Sandoval of Lakers on SI.

list.name: Austin Reaves
list.comment: Reaves (heel) won't undergo imaging and is considered day-to-day ahead of Sunday's game against the Suns, Jovan Buha of The Athletic reports.

list.name: Luka Doncic
list.comment: Head coach JJ Redick said Friday that Doncic (ankle) is "fine," per Law Murray of The Athletic.

list.name: Collin Sexton
list.comment: Sexton did not return to Wednesday's 123-112 win over the Bucks and required stitches to close a cut on his forehead, Thuc Nhi Nguyen of the Los Angeles Times reports.

list.name: Quinten Post
list.comment: Post (concussion) has been ruled out for Friday's game against New Orleans.

list.name: Zach Edey
list.comment: Edey won't play in Friday's game against the Pelicans due to left ankle injury management.

list.name: Scotty Pippen Jr.
list.comment: Pippen (back) remains out for Wednesday's game against Denver, Michael Wallace of the Grizzlies' official site reports.

list.name: Richie Saunders
list.comment: Saunders signed a two-way contract with the Grizzlies on Saturday, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

list.name: Klay Thompson
list.comment: Thompson (ankle) is out for Friday's game against the Cavaliers.

list.name: Pelle Larsson
list.comment: Larsson (illness) is out for Friday's game against Cleveland.

list.name: Anthony Edwards
list.comment: Edwards underwent a successful arthroscopic procedure on his right knee Thursday, the Timberwolves announced.

list.name: Donte DiVincenzo
list.comment: DiVincenzo (Achilles) remains confident that he'll return during the 2026-27 season, Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic reports.

list.name: Dejounte Murray
list.comment: Murray (ankle) is out for Friday's game against Memphis.

list.name: Bryce McGowens
list.comment: McGowens (elbow) is listed as out for Friday's game against the Grizzlies.

list.name: Yves Missi
list.comment: Missi (knee) is out for Friday's game against the Grizzlies.

list.name: Trey Murphy III
list.comment: Murphy (knee) is out for Friday's game against Memphis.

list.name: Trendon Watford
list.comment: Watford (ankle) is listed as out for Friday's game against the Grizzlies.

list.name: Ajay Mitchell
list.comment: Mitchell (ankle) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Clippers.

list.name: Thomas Sorber
list.comment: Sorber (knee) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Clippers.

list.name: Jaylin Williams
list.comment: Williams (back) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against Portland and remains out indefinitely.

list.name: Cason Wallace
list.comment: Wallace underwent surgery Friday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.

list.name: Chet Holmgren
list.comment: Holmgren underwent a biological treatment Friday to address a small patellar tendon tear and will miss at least 8-10 weeks, Nick Crain of Slam reports.

list.name: Jalen Williams
list.comment: Williams (leg) underwent successful surgery Wednesday to "address a fractured left fibula and reconstruction of ankle ligaments following a fracture and dislocation." He will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Tim MacMahon of ESPN.com reports.

list.name: Jonathan Isaac
list.comment: Isaac (knee) is out for Tuesday's game against Sacramento.

list.name: Paolo Banchero
list.comment: Banchero is expected to be sidelined for the next four-to-six weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

list.name: Noah Penda
list.comment: Penda was diagnosed with a partially torn right hamstring Saturday, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

list.name: Izaiyah Nelson
list.comment: Team president Jeff Weltman said Monday that Nelson (ankle) remains about a month away from returning to the court after offseason surgery, per Philip Rossman-Reich of OrlandoMagicDaily.com.

list.name: LeBron James
list.comment: James (back) is out for Thursday's game against Toronto.

list.name: Dominick Barlow
list.comment: Barlow (back) participated in Thursday's shootaround but doesn't have a timeline to return to game action, Ky Carlin of USA Today reports.

list.name: Adem Bona
list.comment: Bona (back) will be re-evaluated in approximately one week after seeing a specialist, Ky Carlin of USA Today reports.

list.name: Ariel Hukporti
list.comment: Hukporti has sustained a season-ending ruptured right Achilles tendon, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

list.name: Drew Timme
list.comment: The Suns claimed Timme off waivers Monday, per Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com.

list.name: Mark Williams
list.comment: Williams underwent surgery Thursday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will miss an extended period of time, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

list.name: Chris Youngblood
list.comment: Youngblood (foot) is out for Friday's game against Sacramento.

list.name: Vit Krejci
list.comment: Krejci underwent surgery on his fractured left ankle Wednesday and will be re-evaluated in eight weeks, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

list.name: Ja Morant
list.comment: Head coach Micah Nori said Morant met with a doctor in Los Angeles, who gave him a positive outlook on his recovery from the hamstring injury. While Nori declined to update Morant's timetable, he added Morant "may not be out for as long as we thought," Trail Blazers Insider Sean Highkin reports.

list.name: Shaedon Sharpe
list.comment: Sharpe suffered a torn meniscus in his knee and is expected to miss six months, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

list.name: Precious Achiuwa
list.comment: Achiuwa (ankle) is out for Friday's game against the Trail Blazers.

list.name: Maxime Raynaud
list.comment: Raynaud (knee) has been ruled out for Tuesday's game against Orlando.

list.name: Ben Simmons
list.comment: Simmons underwent successful surgery Tuesday to repair a torn right Achilles tendon, James Ham of ESPN 1320 Sacramento reports.

list.name: Tobias Harris
list.comment: Harris (calf) is out for Wednesday's game against Chicago, Jared Weiss of The Athletic reports.

list.name: Jayden Quaintance
list.comment: Quaintance has been around the team but has not yet been cleared for basketball activities, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.

list.name: Kevin McCullar Jr.
list.comment: McCullar signed a two-way contract with the Raptors on Thursday, Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com reports.

list.name: Trayce Jackson-Davis
list.comment: Jackson-Davis is out for Thursday's game against the 76ers due to an illness.

list.name: Scottie Barnes
list.comment: Barnes (groin) is out for Thursday's game against Philadelphia.

list.name: Kawhi Leonard
list.comment: Head coach Darko Rajakovic said Wednesday that Leonard (knee) is doing individual on-court work and is progressing well, Michael Grange of Sportsnet.ca reports.

list.name: Nate Bittle
list.comment: Bittle (foot) is listed as out for Monday's game against Memphis.

list.name: Jaxson Hayes
list.comment: Hayes won't return to Friday's game against the Rockets due to a left knee issue.

list.name: Trey Alexander
list.comment: Alexander won't play Wednesday against the Grizzlies due to a left knee bone bruise.

list.name: Lauri Markkanen
list.comment: Markkanen has been diagnosed with a non-displaced fracture in his right hand and will be sidelined for at least one month, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

list.name: Jusuf Nurkic
list.comment: Nurkic (toe) has begun participating in on-court activities as he continues recovering from a right foot injury sustained during an Oct. 4 preseason game against Denver. He will be re-evaluated in two weeks, the Jazz announced Friday.

list.name: Jaren Jackson Jr.
list.comment: Jackson has been diagnosed with a torn MCL in his right knee and will be sidelined for 6-to-8 weeks, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

list.name: Bub Carrington
list.comment: Carrington (chest) has been ruled out for the remainder of Thursday's game against the Pistons.

list.name: Tristan Vukcevic
list.comment: Vukcevic (hip) has been ruled out for Monday's game against Detroit.

list.name: Reece Beekman
list.comment: The Wizards announced Monday that Beekman sustained a right acromioclavicular joint injury and will be re-evaluated in approximately three weeks.

list.name: Justin Champagnie
list.comment: Champagnie (foot) is expected to miss several months, per Josh Robbins of The Athletic.

list.name: Jamir Watkins
list.comment: The Wizards announced Thursday that Watkins has undergone surgery for a torn ACL.
